data: saved grouped exp4 sample; 128 fit per train client after fit+selection refit; 32 holdout per train; up to 128 dev per client
normalization: source mean/scale on fit+selection only; never holdout/dev
consensus_weighting: client fit examples / total fit examples
student_loss_weighting: source total fit examples / all fit examples
primary: fit-example-weighted local teacher PR-AUC on own-client holdouts, mean across five paired seeds
decision: maximize fit-example-weighted local teacher holdout AP; tie within 1e-6: lower total runtime, then name
uncertainty: paired seed deltas per origin; not population confidence; dev clients previously explored
